label.zh: 三处坐标遗址（顺序不限）

note.zh: 每个遗址的最后阶段触发隐藏事件 cstorms.175；只有 pc_arcsite_A、B、C_completed 三个国家标志全部存在时，它才启用项目“机械的用途”。
note.en: The last stage of each site fires hidden cstorms.175; it enables the project only when all three country flags pc_arcsite_A/B/C_completed exist.

notes.zh: 三处“坐标”遗址（A 殖民星球、B 工业星球、C 荒芜星球）由星系初始化器 weathermanipulators_home_system 一次创建（common/solar_system_initializers/cosmic_storm_initializers.txt:31；该初始化器注明“由事件生成，不用于银河生成”）。前一步在另一个故事里：古老风暴庇护所（cstorms.130）的项目“解读坐标”（INETIAN_PROJECTS_01）成功后，cstorms.135 在地图上标出这个星系。
notes.en: The three "Coordinates" sites (A colonised planet, B industrial planet, C barren planet) are created together by the system initializer weathermanipulators_home_system (common/solar_system_initializers/cosmic_storm_initializers.txt:31, which says it is spawned by event, not at galaxy generation). The preceding step is another story: after the ancient storm shelter (cstorms.130) project "Unscramble the Coordinates" (INETIAN_PROJECTS_01), cstorms.135 marks this system on the map.

scope.zh: 整条故事：遗址的出现方式、全部阶段（按定义顺序）、最后结果及其互斥关系、掷骰失败时的事件池；中英文正文已读。
scope.en: Whole story: how the site appears, every stage in definition order, the final outcome(s) and their exclusivity, the roll-failure incident pool; both languages read.

uncertain: When the system is spawned: the initializer comment says it is spawned by event; that event belongs to the earlier Inetian story (from cstorms.100), outside this one.
